summary: This topic explains how to configure and manage the various sources from which admission leads originate, such as direct walk-ins, newspaper advertisements, online ads, or third-party integrations. It also covers the option to enable reference tracking.
steps: Navigate to the 'Source part' within the Admission Master setup.
Click 'Add new details' to define a new lead source.
Enter the name of the source (e.g., 'Direct Walk-in', 'Newspaper Ad', 'Google Ad', 'Website', 'CollegeDuniya').
Optionally, toggle on the 'Reference field' if you wish to track specific references associated with leads from this source.
business_rules: Leads can originate from multiple sources, and tracking these sources helps in analysis.
Enabling the 'Reference field' adds additional input options for capturing reference details when a lead is being added.
important_notes: Common sources include online platforms, offline campaigns, and direct interactions.
High-end colleges or universities may integrate with third-party platforms for lead generation.
